title: Test rejection of structured review retries differing from both projections
outcome: Third context-cost review identified a negative-test gap at record_delegation_review_submission. Positive legacy-projection retry is covered, but add a test that changes an inspected path or free-form note so the stored result equals neither current nor legacy projection, then assert the 409 already-submitted-different-result conflict. No correctness defect was found; both branches use full structural equality. Follow-up to tm-dsmm; reviewed source in codex/context-cost, full gate test-7b51a389 PASS.
acceptance: A test on master submits a structured review retry whose stored result matches neither the current nor the legacy projection (a changed free-form note, or a changed inspected path, for both the current and the legacy persisted shape) and asserts 409 'delegation already submitted a different structured review result' with the stored result unchanged.
The positive legacy-projection retry test still exists and asserts acceptance.
